cards.name: Absorbing Kid from the Sky
cards.effectSummary: After this monster destroys another monster by battle and that monster is sent to the Graveyard, its controller gains 300 Life Points for each Level of the destroyed monster.

cards.name: Guardian Angel Joan
cards.effectSummary: When this monster destroys another monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, it recovers Life Points equal to that monster's original ATK in the Graveyard.

tagDuelAdapter.eventSource: trusted committed battle-destruction snapshot; not inferred from translated logs
tagDuelAdapter.sourceController: recipient is the source's controller team at the battle event, not physical owner seat
tagDuelAdapter.physicalOwnership: UID-derived source and destroyed-card physical owner seats are preserved; destroyed card must reach the physical owner's team Graveyard to qualify
tagDuelAdapter.levelAndAtk: destroyed monster Level and original ATK are read from certified catalog metadata
tagDuelAdapter.destination: replacement destinations are validated against actual inventory zones and do not trigger recovery
tagDuelAdapter.deduplication: eventId ledger rejects replays and returns a new immutable processed-event list
tagDuelAdapter.stateMutation: none; returns new shared team LP totals for an atomic caller commit

behavioralGroups: Guardian Angel Joan original ATK recovery
source controller team versus physical owner seat
replacement destination, battle and destroyer gates
event identity, duplicate UID and replay protection
